description: Expected answers of the shared consistent-hash ring. Every port must reproduce all of them. Generated by `npm run vectors` in hash-ring/; do not edit by hand.

algorithm.hash: FNV-1a 32-bit over the UTF-8 bytes (offset basis 0x811c9dc5, prime 0x01000193), then murmur3 fmix32
algorithm.order: points sorted by hash ascending, ties by node name (byte order)
algorithm.lookup: first point with hash >= hash32(key), wrapping to the first point
